model: Qalcosonic E3 / E4 heat meter BACnet MS/TP module
applies_to: Axioma Qalcosonic E3 and E4 modular ultrasonic heat (and cooling) meters fitted with the Axioma BACnet MS/TP module.
summary: A plug-in BACnet MS/TP module for the Qalcosonic E3/E4 heat meter. It polls the meter (default every 300 s) and serves 14 read-only Analog Inputs: heat and cooling energy, tariff registers, volume, two pulse inputs, power, flow, flow/return/differential temperature and the meter info code.
notes: Instances are sparse (AI 0-6, 8, 11, 14, 19-21, 30) as printed in the object table; the Object_List example on p4 numbers them differently, the table IDs are used here.
Energy units follow the meter set-up (kWh or MWh); pulse inputs may be volume or energy.
Vendor ID 1006. Device instance = last 5 digits of the meter serial number.

source.title: BACnet MS/TP Module for Modular Heat Meter Qalcosonic E3/E4

integration.summary: Read-only meter: poll heat energy, power, flow and the two temperatures, and alarm on the info code.
setup: MAC 1-127 follows the meter's M-Bus address; baud 9600-115200 (default 38400), 8E1.
Data refresh interval defaults to 300 s (configurable).
A RESET button restores module defaults after a bad configuration.
gotchas: Values update only at the module's polling interval, not continuously.

points.name: Pulse input A accumulated / Accumulated volume (V2)
Pulse input B accumulated / Accumulated volume (V3)
